zh-CN.title: 闪图查看与消息转发
items: 闪图与图片气泡样式一致。发送者可重复查看，也能看到收件人查看状态。
你发送的闪图和语音可逐条或合并转发到聊天。

en.title: Flash photo receipts and forwarding
items: Flash photos now use the photo bubble style. Senders can reopen them and see how many recipients have viewed them.
Forward your own flash photos and voice messages individually or in chat history bundles.
